hook: About 24 custom kernels to run Inkling on a Mac

beats.say: Developer David Dalcu added support for Thinking Machines' Inkling 2 Mini to MLX-Serve, his server for running models locally on Apple Silicon Macs.
After writing about 24 custom kernels, he says it might be the fastest way to run the model on a Mac today.
The pre-release ships 8-bit, NVFP4 and MXFP8 versions, with an 8-bit build on Hugging Face. A 4-bit version did not pass his quality bar yet.
